fabrictemplateserver.settings.desc: Shared config values powered by Fzzy Config.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.fallbackDa: Bare double example from the Fzzy docs. It serializes, but it is not validated and does not generate a config widget.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.logConfigO: Write the currently loaded config values during common mod initialization.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.welcomeMes: Example synced text value stored in the shared config.

fabrictemplateserver.settings.broadcastS: Validated choice example with a small fixed set of allowed string values.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.syncMode.d: Validated enum example for cycling through a few preset behaviors.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.featuredIt: Validated identifier example using a Minecraft item id.

fabrictemplateserver.settings.gameplay.e: Nested boolean example inside a ConfigSection.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.gameplay.b: Nested validated integer example inside a ConfigSection.
fabrictemplateserver.settings.gameplay.s: Nested validated string example inside a ConfigSection.
